_note: Sample 12 — 15 fresh READ tasks across 15 new domains, driven live post-sutradhar@0.4.0 npm publish. User asked for a full re-benchmark of the newly published version specifically to check whether the combined completion rate has crossed 65%. Full re-testing of all 103 prior tasks was judged impractical (many hours) and low-value (external blocks like Cloudflare/CAPTCHA/site outages don't change with Sutradhar's version) — following this project's established rolling-sample methodology instead, combining this fresh sample's result into the running total.
